stops.name: Alto Garda Bresciano Regional Park
stops.detail: The Alto Garda Bresciano Regional Park (Italian: Parco regionale dell'Alto Garda Bresciano) is a nature reserve in Lombardy, Italy. Established in 1989, it covers the western coast of Lake Garda between Salò and Limone sul Garda (Riviera dei Limoni), the Valle Sabbia and the mountains between the lake and the border with Trentino. The highest point is the peak of Monte Caplone, 1,976 meters above sea level, whereas the lowest point is the lake, 65 meters above sea level.
